_help: Your channel's identity. YouTube approves channels that look like one creator with one point of view, not a content farm - so fill this in and keep it stable. Every script uses it.
name: My Channel
niche: Explaining true stories and today's news in simple Hindi
audience: Indian viewers aged 18-35 who want the full story in a few minutes

host.name: Pratik
host.personality: calm, curious, honest; explains like a friend; gives his own view clearly marked as opinion

point_of_view: Every video must add something a viewer cannot get from reading the headline: why it matters, what most people miss, and one clear takeaway.
avoid: clickbait that the video does not pay off
medical, legal or money advice presented as expert advice
copying another channel's script or story
